_about: Supervision bench cases. Invented sessions, no client data, typed the way a BCBA types between sessions. fields are typed into the page by label, toggles pressed by group name; truth answers the page's follow-up questions; expect holds the checks (scripts/bench/lib/checks.mjs). Each case tests a different rule in sup.js: picks only when supported, made versus needed, one owner per facet, honest brevity on thin input.
